faces.name: Assault Suit

triggered.raw_text: At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, you may have that player gain control of equipped creature until end of turn. If you do, untap it.

static_abilities.raw_text: Equipped creature gets +2/+2, has haste, can't attack you or planeswalkers you control, and can't be sacrificed.
